title: DeepSpace Plant-Stress to Germinating-Seed Decoder (DSRS + GSAD) and seed-susceptibility atlas
description: FAIR tools and atlas for plant space biology: DSRS recognizes space-stressor transcriptional signatures; GSAD decodes bulk transcriptomics onto dry/germinating-seed cell types. Includes the DeepSpace seed-susceptibility atlas (cell-type/tissue/stage x stressor family) supporting an npj Microgravity manuscript.
